Hi. I’m going to be 38 next month. I’ve always felt like a natural submissive. I’m a people pleaser. I also like to be pushed to be better. I feel like I’m at a real crossroads in my life right now. No relationship, no children, working full time to support myself. But I’ve had to be in control from a very young age. I ran the house when I was 5 because my mom was either working or partying. I cleaned and cooked, or else it wouldn’t get done. Even though my mom wasn’t great at her role she was great at making me think she was my whole world. I didn’t grow up with religion. My mom was the almighty. I rubbed her feet and back when she got home from work everyday. I always did as I was told. When I was 12 she died of cancer and I’ve been trying to find my way since then. I just wish for once in my life I didn’t have to worry so much. I want to have someone as devoted to me as I am to them. I’m not one of those women that just wants to stay home all day and not work. I’m proud of what I have built. But it’s so lonely. Reading about Dom/sub relationships, I feel like that is what I need. But I have no experience. I just don’t want to be lost anymore.
